reasons: The student's per-semester MC limit is 4, but all required courses (CS3210, CS2101, CS3281, CS2102, CS3236, ST2334, CS2103T) are 4 MC each. It is impossible to take more than one required course per semester. With 7 courses to fit into semesters 5, 7, and 8 (Sem 6 is exchange), at least one semester must contain 2 or more courses, exceeding the 4 MC limit.
